causal_graphs.context: Rosas2002 Figure 1B; pGR51C/pET20b protein, 37 C, 187 nM; separate diacetyl-[14C]Lys-tRNA and acetyl-[14C]Phe-tRNA assays. E. coli Pth and no-enzyme controls; subsequent recharging with the appropriate aminoacylation system.

evidence.explanation: Figure1B, recombinant-enzyme Results and reaminoacylation Methods; R1 in the retained ledger. TLC of extract is not recast as purified-enzyme product identification.
evidence.snippet: The enzyme was able to hydrolyze both substrates

edges.mechanism: Purified-protein hydrolysis followed by Lys recharging supports release of functional tRNA rather than a nuclease-only explanation.
edges.subject: lys_reaction

evidence.explanation: Figure1B and recombinant-enzyme Results; R1. Distinct substrate, not a second independent publication.
evidence.snippet: The enzyme was able to hydrolyze both substrates

edges.mechanism: The separately tested acetyl-Phe substrate yields tRNA that can be recharged; this does not establish all peptide substrates.
edges.subject: phe_reaction

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q60363 sequence version 1, entry version 131, 115 aa, MJ0051; current PF01981 spans 1-115. The paper cites NP_247015.1. Physical vector junctions are not independently verified; evidence/PF01981/member-mapping.txt.
causal_graphs.limitations: No natural peptide-length series or atomic catalytic pathway. Substrate units differ between Methods and Figure1A; no silently corrected Figure1B concentration. Image was inaccessible; Methods, Results and caption inspected. Recharging is a product-integrity assay, not cellular translation flux.

nodes.label: MJ0051 plus diacetyl-Lys-tRNA in the defined assay
MJ0051 plus acetyl-Phe-tRNA in the defined assay

causal_graphs.scope: Recombinant M. jannaschii MJ0051 with C-terminal His6, not all PF01981 members.
causal_graphs.title: Purified MJ0051 releases reaminoacylatable tRNAs

causal_graphs.context: Table 1; LB, ampicillin 0.1 mg/ml, IPTG 1 uM; 42 C versus 32 C. Empty pKQV4 and E. coli pth comparators; cured clones regain temperature sensitivity.

evidence.explanation: Table1 and complementation Results, including cured-clone control; ledger R2.
evidence.snippet: Both pth genes, but not the empty vector

edges.mechanism: Growth rescue depends on retention of the MJ0051 plasmid under these conditions; intervening cellular events are unresolved.
edges.subject: plasmid

causal_graphs.family_mapping: MJ0051 maps to Q60363/PF01981 reference 1-115. The rescue plasmid is not the tagged purified-enzyme construct; native archaeal essentiality is not tested.
causal_graphs.limitations: Rescue measures growth, not intracellular substrate abundance or a direct translation step. Native host and isolated-domain necessity remain untested; pth-null rescue is only reported without displayed data and not a separate edge.
causal_graphs.scope: Whole MJ0051 gene supplied in pGR518 to an E. coli temperature-sensitive pth background.
causal_graphs.title: MJ0051 complements E. coli C600 pth-ts

causal_graphs.context: Table 1 and yeast Results; E. coli C600 pth-ts, 42 C, LB/ampicillin/IPTG as in the 2002 complementation assay. Full-length pGRAS did not rescue in that experiment.

evidence.explanation: Table1 and yeast Results; R3. Host and construct are not pooled with Fromant2003.

edges.mechanism: This historical yeast-derived construct supports bacterial growth; the direct cellular mechanism and reason for the full-length negative are unresolved.
edges.subject: truncated

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Gene correspondence to P34222 supports family identity; current sequence version 2 is 208 aa with PF01981 at 89-208. Do not equate the historical deleted 86 residues with today's numbering; the physical old insert remains unresolved.
causal_graphs.limitations: No matched expression, folding or targeting measurements. No claim that the N-terminus intrinsically inhibits catalysis or proves organellar localization. The2003 full-length rescue is preserved separately.
causal_graphs.scope: YBL057c-derived pGR87L, with the source's N-terminal 86-residue deletion and initiation-codon substitution.
causal_graphs.title: Historical truncated yeast PTH2 rescues C600 pth-ts

causal_graphs.context: Fromant2003 Figure 1 and Table 5, 50 C; Tris pH 7.5, EDTA, DTT and standard 10 mM MgCl2 assay. Periodate-treated Lys substrate plus subsequent LysRS/ATP recharging tests tRNA integrity; other substrates use deacylation kinetics.

evidence.explanation: Figure1 caption, corresponding Methods/Results, ledger S1. The no-enzyme baseline is nonzero.

edges.mechanism: Product recharging accompanies substrate loss, with pre-existing uncharged tRNA inactivated and a no-PTH comparator. This supports tRNA-releasing hydrolysis without specifying catalytic residues.
edges.subject: lys_assay

evidence.explanation: Table5 formyl-methionyl row and substrate-specificity Results, not the quotation alone, support this edge; ledger S1. Product recharge was separately tested only for Lys.

edges.mechanism: Purified-enzyme substrate kinetics establish deacylation of the E. coli initiator substrate in vitro, not depletion in living bacteria or native archaeal initiation.
edges.subject: fmet_assay

evidence.explanation: Table5 acetyl-histidyl row and substrate-specificity Results; ledger S1. The measured substrate-specific result supplies the relation.

edges.mechanism: The tested acetyl-His substrate is deacylated under the purified-enzyme conditions; a universal tRNA-identity rule is not inferred.
edges.subject: his_assay

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q980V1 sequence version 1, entry version 128, 120 aa, SSO0175; N-terminal Edman match. Later SIFTS 1XTY PF01981 spans 2-120. Mapping does not independently authenticate the 2003 physical insert.
causal_graphs.limitations: Artificial N-blocked aminoacyl substrates, not a natural peptidyl-tRNA census. Functional recharging was established for Lys, not independently for every substrate. Table5 Km estimates for other substrates assume competitive tRNA-Lys inhibition. Figure1 caption/text, not its unavailable image, inspected.
causal_graphs.scope: Recombinant S. solfataricus P2 SSO0175, with distinct substrate-specific assays.
causal_graphs.title: Purified SSO0175 hydrolyzes defined N-blocked aminoacyl-tRNAs

causal_graphs.context: 50 C, 20 mM Tris pH 7.5, 0.1 mM EDTA, 0.1 mM DTT, 0.75 uM substrate; enzyme 0.1-10 nM. No-addition baseline 0.026/s. Reported standard errors below 20%.

evidence.explanation: Table3 magnesium comparison and footnote; ledger S2. Not a combined cofactor requirement.
evidence.snippet: each of these compounds stimulated the rate

edges.mechanism: Table 3 reports 2.3/s with 40 mM MgCl2 versus 0.026/s without an added compound; the molecular origin of the increase is unresolved.
edges.subject: magnesium

evidence.explanation: Table3 potassium row and assay footnote; ledger S2.
evidence.snippet: each of these compounds stimulated the rate

edges.mechanism: The separate 300 mM KCl condition gives 2.0/s versus the no-addition baseline; no monotonic salt-response rule is asserted.
edges.subject: potassium

evidence.explanation: Table3 spermidine row; ledger S2. No physiological polyamine-regulation claim.
evidence.snippet: each of these compounds stimulated the rate

edges.mechanism: The separate 0.1 mM spermidine-HCl condition gives 1.9/s; substrate folding is an interpretation, not a directly measured intermediate.
edges.subject: spermidine

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q980V1/SSO0175; reference PF01981 at 2-120 in 1XTY. Whole purified protein, not an isolated mutant domain.
causal_graphs.limitations: Rate effects do not independently demonstrate tRNA compaction, direct ion binding or catalytic metal necessity. Enzyme concentration varies with rate; these are normalized specific activities. No assertion that all salt concentrations activate.

nodes.label: Separate 40 mM MgCl2 addition versus no addition
Separate 300 mM KCl addition versus no addition
Separate 0.1 mM spermidine-HCl addition versus no addition

causal_graphs.scope: Purified SSO0175 and diacetyl-Lys-tRNA under Table3 conditions; separate additions, not joint necessary cofactors.
causal_graphs.title: Separate ionic additions increase the SSO0175 assay rate

causal_graphs.context: Fromant2003 Methods/Table 6; 50 C, Tris pH 7.5, EDTA, DTT; varied inhibitor/substrate concentrations. Table 6 specifies 0.2 uM substrate and 0.075 nM enzyme; the general Methods include MgCl2 but Table 6 omits it.

evidence.explanation: Methods inhibition series and Table6; ledger S3. Distinguish measured rate inhibition from inferred binding mechanism.
evidence.snippet: strong inhibition of the hydrolytic reaction

edges.mechanism: Initial-rate measurements support inhibition with a competitive fit for tRNA-Lys; no direct atomic binding interaction is assigned.
edges.subject: lys_trna

evidence.explanation: Table6 tRNA-fMet row and Results; ledger S3. No measured binding Kd or demonstrated tRNA-fMet competitive mode is claimed.
evidence.snippet: strong inhibition of the hydrolytic reaction

edges.mechanism: The separate uncharged initiator-tRNA titration inhibits deacylation; this is not evidence that a native feedback circuit operates.
edges.subject: fmet_trna

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q980V1/SSO0175; later 1XTY PF01981 mapping 2-120. Nucleic-acid recognition is tested with the whole protein.
causal_graphs.limitations: Preserve ionic-condition ambiguity. Reported inhibition constants are not directly measured binding affinities. Competitive behavior was explicitly checked for tRNA-Lys; native feedback and binding-site geometry remain unresolved. rRNA/DNA negatives are assay-specific.
causal_graphs.scope: Separate E. coli tRNA-Lys and tRNA-fMet additions to purified archaeal PTH2 assays.
causal_graphs.title: Uncharged tRNAs inhibit the SSO0175 hydrolysis assay

causal_graphs.context: Fromant2003 identification Results; 42 C eliminates the temperature-sensitive pMAKpth source of bacterial Pth. Empty pTrc99-A fails to yield thermoresistant clones.

evidence.explanation: SSO0175 identification Results and strain Table1; ledger S4. Not the separate yeast pKK construct.

edges.mechanism: The introduced archaeal gene supplies a function sufficient for growth in this bacterial complementation setting; intervening in-cell steps are not directly assayed.
edges.subject: gene

causal_graphs.family_mapping: SSO0175/Q980V1 reference sequence version 1; PF01981 mapping 2-120. Whole-gene complementation, not a domain-only intervention.
causal_graphs.limitations: No direct intracellular tRNA measurement or native archaeal essentiality test. Excess-expression toxicity in XL1-Blue is a different context, not a contradiction of this rescue.
causal_graphs.scope: S. solfataricus SSO0175/pTrc-pthS in E. coli K37delta-pthTr.
causal_graphs.title: SSO0175 supports growth after E. coli Pth supply is lost

causal_graphs.context: Fromant2003 homolog Results; E. coli K37delta-pthTr at 42 C with loss of pMAKpth. Table 7 crude-extract activity is supporting context, not a purified yeast-enzyme assay.

evidence.explanation: Homolog Results and explicit comparison with Rosas2002; ledger S4/N1. Native yeast deletion results are not a positive mechanism edge.

edges.mechanism: Full-length yeast-gene transformants grow after loss of the bacterial Pth maintenance plasmid; this is a separate reported rescue, not a resolution of the earlier negative.
edges.subject: gene

causal_graphs.family_mapping: YBL057C corresponds to P34222, current 208-aa sequence version 2, with PF01981 at 89-208. The full physical historical insert is not independently sequence-verified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Different vector, host and expression conditions from2002; no head-to-head resolution of full-length failure versus rescue. Do not infer localization or that truncation universally changes catalytic efficiency.
causal_graphs.scope: Source-reported full-length YBL057c in pKKpthY2, distinct from2002 pGRAS and pGR87L.
causal_graphs.title: Full-length yeast YBL057c rescues a different E. coli pth background

causal_graphs.context: Kawashima2026 Methods 2.5/Figure 5; 20 nM enzyme, 1 uM diacetyl-[14C]Lys-tRNA, 20 mM HEPES-KOH pH 7.6, 150 mM KCl, 10 mM MgCl2, 7 mM beta-mercaptoethanol; 50 ul, 1 min, supernatant radiolabel. Same substrate batch; PhPth2 comparison; three independent experiments, SD.

evidence.explanation: Original Figure5 image and Results3.3 supply the direction, Methods2.5 the shared-substrate control; ledger L2. No numerical bar digitization.
evidence.snippet: The same batch of substrate was used for all temperature conditions.

edges.mechanism: Figure 5 reports greater activity at 60 C than 20 C under the defined assay; no continuous curve or precise optimum between sampled temperatures is inferred.
edges.subject: warm

evidence.explanation: Figure5 image/caption and Results3.3; ledger L2/N1. This is not an irreversible heat-inactivation or growth experiment.
evidence.snippet: The same batch of substrate was used for all temperature conditions.

edges.mechanism: The 70 C response is below 60 C while the PhPth2 comparator retains activity; the underlying structural transition is not directly measured.
edges.subject: hotter

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Table 1 core equals archived A0A0F9U5Y0 entry version 19, sequence version 1, 118 aa, which explicitly maps PF01981; PDB 24BT entity 1 carries the same core plus a different tag. Accession currently deleted; HMM boundaries unresolved. Taxon 1538547 follows the deposition; historical metagenome taxonomy retained in member-mapping.txt.
causal_graphs.limitations: One-minute rate response does not establish irreversible protein denaturation or environmental growth optimum. Comparator limits substrate-only explanations but no separate Figure5 blank or raw replicate data were inspected. Structural salt-bridge and substrate-binding hypotheses are not OBSERVED edges.
causal_graphs.scope: Synthetic LCGC14_0646670-derived protein with GPH cleavage remnant, not the C-terminally tagged crystal sample or live archaeal growth.
causal_graphs.title: LokiPth2 assay activity rises to 60 C and falls at 70 C

record.description: Peptidyl-tRNA hydrolases are enzymes that release tRNAs from peptidyl-tRNA during translation.

evidence.explanation: MJ0051 and historical YBL057c constructs are named, but current P34222 sequence2 numbering is not an authenticated remapping of the old truncation.
Table1 supplies distinct activity and crystal sequences; archived UniProt entry19 maps their identical core to PF01981, but current HMM boundaries remain unresolved.

discussions.notes: See evidence/PF01981/member-mapping.txt. Whole-protein rescue is not isolated-domain necessity. Obtain original Fromant2005 mutant data and folding/abundance controls before claiming atomic chemistry.
discussions.prompt: Resolve historical physical constructs and domain coordinates before stronger domain-specific or residue claims.
discussions.rationale: Reference-domain mappings do not independently sequence assay constructs; yeast sequence versions and the retired Lokiarchaeum accession need explicit treatment.

evidence.explanation: Full-length pKKpthY2 rescue contrasts with pGRAS failure in2002. Host/vector/expression differences prevent pooling. YHR189w respiratory defects are Pth1 results.
Figure5 measures one-minute enzyme activity, not organism growth or an irreversible-denaturation curve; structure resolution text disagrees with Table3 and deposition.

discussions.notes: Retain native yeast deletion negatives as condition-specific, not universal dispensability. Do not infer mitochondrial localization, tRNA-folding causality, toxicity mechanisms or thermal niches from these graphs.
discussions.prompt: Resolve source discrepancies and distinguish heterologous rescue and assay responses from native physiology.
discussions.rationale: Full-length yeast complementation differs between2002 and2003; original substrate units, Table6 ionic conditions and2026 resolution values also differ.

evidence.explanation: Abstract and later citations are discovery leads only; full mutation assays have not been inspected here.

discussions.notes: Follow yeast UBL/proteasome and human PTRH2/BIT1 primary studies, older uninspected figures, the2026 supplement and other archaeal members. Structural resemblance and automated annotations are not experimental transfer.
discussions.prompt: Extend primary-source review to residue experiments, eukaryotic roles and additional exact PF01981 members.
discussions.rationale: Three inspected studies do not complete this diverse family's mechanism coverage.
